_help: Campus moments: timed nudges the founders send from their phone. Each has a note to the ambassador and a message they can forward. Placeholders: {name}, {school}, {link} (their group chat link), {page} (their private page). Dates are rough; founders pick the real week per school.

moments.label: welcome-back weekend
moments.to_ambassador: hey {name}, welcome-back weekend is the easiest time to drop smooth in a chat, everyone's resetting. here's one ready to go. no pressure, whenever you see this.
moments.forward: new semester, new system: smooth pulls every canvas + gradescope deadline into one list and reminds you before things close. free, built by students. {link}

moments.label: first week of classes
moments.to_ambassador: {name}, syllabi are dropping this week and nobody has their deadlines sorted yet. if you're in a class-year or dorm chat, this one fits.
moments.forward: before the syllabi pile up: smooth puts all your deadlines from canvas and gradescope in one place and pings you before they close. 2 min to set up, free. {link}

moments.label: add/drop deadline
moments.to_ambassador: add/drop closes this week at {school}, so schedules are final. people are making their systems now. here's a short one if you want to post it.
moments.forward: schedules are locked, so now's the time: smooth takes your canvas + gradescope deadlines and turns them into one list with reminders. free. {link}

moments.to_ambassador: midterms at {school} this week? that's when people miss the small stuff. the message below is about that. only if you have a sec.

moments.to_ambassador: finals week. honestly, not a time to post much. this one's short, and if you'd rather skip it, skip it. good luck on yours.
